messages:
rachel: Proposal: add a compact shorthand flag `--shorthand=<name>` to /deploy that maps to vetted templates. Aim: fewer typos during incidents.
max: Agree. We should call them `shorthands` not presets to avoid naming collision.
ops_lead: Requirements: 1) every shorthand must have an owner, 2) edits create new versions and need re-approval for prod, 3) audit trail required.
rachel: UX sketch: `/deploy --shorthand=ramp-small --dry-run --why` prints who last edited it and the expanded flags. Also support `/deploy shorthand save <name> --spec '<json>'` and `/deploy shorthand list`.
deploy-bot: Implementation: store shorthands in k/v with encryption. Add `/deploy shorthand lint <name>` that enforces rules like pin required if canary>20%, no immediate 100% unless pinned, and change_window inside allowed times.
max: Add simulation: `/deploy --shorthand=ramp-small --simulate metrics.csv` returns timeline and whether rollback would have triggered. Useful for runbook rehearsals.
ops_lead: Also add `--approved-by` on apply for prod targets. For auto-rollback, bot should require two approvers to undo.
docs: I'll update runbooks and write a short cheat sheet showing common shorthands and `--why` output.
rachel: Action items: rachel to RFC schema, max to prototype simulate runner, deploy-bot to add lint + audit logging, ops to share approval list. Plan: land MVP on staging and test for 1 week.
